monday.stop_condition: Only if someone shows one step that solves a real reporting pain with a depot file
monday.blocker: No time, and the reporting data sits in a system I cannot export from without IT

misconception.why: All examples were about research, strategy and documents. Nothing was about operations or a depot. The Slack message demo was closest, but it did not change my idea that AI is for customer chat.

one_line: Too many words and too much about strategy. The only things I took are use one agent first, and check the facts yourself.
